description: How to finish one deck (id or name) with `budget` to spend, in `currency` (default USD): the missing copies bought cheapest first while the budget lasts (`buy`, with `text` as "4 Card Name" lines for a shop), the copies that do not fit (`over_budget`, `over_by`), and the cards with no price yet (`no_price_yet`, left out of every total). A price is the cheapest non-foil printing among the priced ones, or the pinned printing's when the list pins one. Each over-budget card carries `owned_stand_ins`: cards the user owns with copies no deck claims outright, in the deck's colour identity, and `cheaper_to_buy`: cards whose cheapest price for every copy of the line fits what is left of the budget. With `stand_ins_by` "rules text" both come from the cards nearest by rules text (a nearer mana value and a more played card first), legal in the format; with "type and mana value" (no list for the card yet) they are mechanical filters only, still legal in the format, and `cheaper_to_buy` is empty; null for the commander, which gets none. Either way YOU judge whether one does the job. Say `proxies` beside a stand-in that has any, and name every deck in its `shared_with`: those copies are already borrowed. A line's `claimed_by_other_decks` means the user owns copies another deck claims: say so before they buy (claim_from_collection with allow_shared can borrow them). Name the cards in `printings_not_compared` as possibly cheaper: some of their printings have no price yet, and the nightly price refresh reaches every printing within a week (`prices_queued` is always 0: this tool queues nothing). Copies the user owns free (`claimable`) are not missing: run claim_from_collection first. Read-only: it changes nothing and starts no work. Relay `rate_missing` when present. `stand_ins_withheld`, when present, means the user's plan has no stand-ins: relay it once, as written.

currency.description: Display currency. USD/EUR come from Scryfall; CHF is always EUR × the stored ECB rate. A response that carries `rate_missing` could not price in CHF at all: tell the user that, not that the cards have no price.
